title: Standardize progress update timestamps
summary: Standardize WebView progress update timestamp display to a date-then-time string.
reason: Progress bars could show raw ISO timestamps with fractional seconds and trailing UTC markers, making the Run Progress and Audit progress detail lines noisy.
behavior_before: Progress bar subtitles displayed updated_at exactly as the backend reported it, including strings such as 2026-05-22T19:42:39.4749504Z.
behavior_after: Progress bar subtitles display updated_at as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS when the value starts with an ISO-like date/time, while leaving already formatted or non-date values readable.

rollback_plan: Revert the progressView.js formatter/wiring and remove the focused timestamp render smoke from test_application_facade_web_static.py.
notes:
Progress bar update timestamps will display as date then time without fractional seconds or trailing UTC markers.
